{{Short description|Catholic statistic to determine parish activity level}}
The '''sacramental index''' is a [[statistic]] sometimes used by [[Roman Catholic]] [[Bishop#Catholic, Eastern Orthodox, Oriental Orthodox, Lutheran and Anglican churches|bishops]] as a rough approximation of how active a [[parish]] is, based on the occurrence of [[sacrament]]s or [[rite of passage|rites of passage]].  The precise formula varies; in  the [[Archdiocese]] of [[Boston, Massachusetts|Boston]], the sacramental index for a parish is calculated by adding the total numbers of [[baptism]]s and [[funeral]]s, and twice the number of [[Christian view of marriage|weddings]].<ref name="bane-coffin-higgins-2005"/>

The index is used to help determine the number of priests assigned to a parish.
